title: Dock sell e2e: sell cargo in the browser at a station terminal (counter 500 to 525)
description: The last substantive piece of TASK-40: a Playwright e2e that plays the full browser sell loop — disembark at the pad, park at the dock terminal, open the dock panel, sell the on-foot iron, and assert the credits counter updates (500 to 525) with a screenshot. This e2e is also the FIRST browser verification of the client DockPanel/credits HUD built in 3122ad1 (it was never run in a browser), so any client wiring bug it exposes is root-caused and fixed here. The server side (shard.handleSell + POST /api/ships/sell) is already covered by 33 green tests and should not need changes.

steps.details: Mirror tests/e2e/cargo.spec.ts exactly: `import { expect, test } from './fixtures'`, `collectErrors`/`uniqueCallsign` from './helpers', `RawWsClient` from './raw-ws', `const PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1`, `test.setTimeout(150_000)`, one test with `{ browser, e2eServer }` and `const { baseURL, apiPort } = e2eServer`. Flow — (1) server-side raw REST+WS: POST /api/callsigns (claim) -> GET /api/dev/pad-target AND GET /api/dev/terminal-target -> over RawWsClient (ws://127.0.0.1:${apiPort}/ws): hello/auth/join home system + warp to the pad's system -> POST /api/dev/teleport to pad.pos (the pad machine docks the ship) -> POST /api/dev/give 5 iron -> close the raw client. (2) browser: new context, `page.evaluate` localStorage.setItem('drift.session.v1', JSON.stringify(session)) (exact key as cargo.spec.ts line ~121), page.goto(`${baseURL}/?sys=${target.systemId}`); wait for #ship-hud-cargo visible (in-ship); press 'e' (disembark); wait for #weight-bar text matching /5\/40u/ (on-foot carrying 5 iron). (3) server: POST /api/dev/teleport-char with the Bearer token to {x: term.pos.x + 1.5, y: term.pos.y, z: term.pos.z} — the disembark spawn is ~15.5 m from the terminal, past both the 3 m interact and the 10 m sell range, so the walk must be teleported. (4) browser: spin to face the terminal — hold 'd' until #interact-prompt contains '[E] Dock terminal' (timeout 30_000; if the direction misses, also try holding 'a'), release, press 'e' -> #dock-panel opens (the 'ui-open' dock payload now carries hold+inventory, so it opens fully populated — do not expect a cargo_open flow). (5) assert #credits-counter shows '500 cr' (boot-seeded from GET /api/players/me); click #dock-panel button[aria-label="sell all iron inv"]; assert #credits-counter updates to '525 cr' (500 + 5*5 — iron base price 5, TASK-37 catalog) within one snapshot and the panel's iron row drops to 0 (source stack decreased); page.screenshot({ path: '.ralph/screenshots/TASK-40-1.png' }); console-clean assert via the collectErrors pattern. Note: the local CharacterPredictor reconciles to the server teleport on the next 10 Hz snapshot (~100 ms), so the spin must start only after that — the 30 s prompt timeout absorbs it.

steps.description: Fix client bugs the e2e exposes (if any)
steps.details: The client dock-sell code was built in 3122ad1 without ever running in a browser: src/client/state/dock.ts (openDockPanel(terminalId, hold, inventory) / applySellResult / closeDockPanel), state/credits.ts, state/credit-float.ts, ui/dock-panel.tsx, ui/credits-hud.tsx, and the main.tsx handlers (ui-open -> openDockPanel, 'sell' result frame -> applySellResult + setCredits + pushCreditFloat, boot fetch of GET /api/players/me). If the e2e fails, root-cause in the client (ui-open payload parsing, onSell dispatch to the WS 'sell' frame, counter seeding, result-frame handling, float rendering) and fix under app/src/client/; the server handler is already covered by shard.sell.test.ts + sell.ws.test.ts and should be left untouched unless the evidence is unambiguous. Re-run the spec until green.

cd app && npx tsc --noEmit (green); npx eslint --fix + npx prettier --write on every touched file (the new spec + any client fixes); re-run npm run test:e2e sell.spec.ts one final time (green — the fixture boots the real dev server itself, do NOT also run npm run dev); confirm the screenshot shows the dock panel + updated counter and is not a black/empty frame (desktop browser if available, else a pixel-stat check like the TASK-37 iteration did); commit with a Conventional Commit message (e.g. 'test(sell): TASK-40.1 dock-sell e2e ...'). Do NOT run the full npm run test suite here — it is TASK-40.2's job. If time runs short, leave an updated .ralph/handoff/TASK-40.md naming exactly what is left (the TASK-40.2 close-out).

acceptanceCriteria: app/tests/e2e/sell.spec.ts exists and mirrors cargo.spec.ts (same imports, PROTOCOL_VERSION const, raw REST+WS server prep, browser assertion style, 150 s timeout, console-clean assert)

cd app && npm run test:e2e sell.spec.ts is green: claim -> raw-WS dock -> give 5 iron -> browser in-ship -> disembark -> teleport to terminal -> '[E] Dock terminal' prompt -> E -> #dock-panel shows the iron row (base price 5, 'hold 0 - inv 5' style sources) -> click 'sell all iron inv' -> #credits-counter 500 cr -> 525 cr and the inventory row decreases to 0

Sell feedback visible: the floating '+25 cr' text appears (CreditFloatLayer) and .ralph/screenshots/TASK-40-1.png shows the dock panel + the updated credits counter (verify content, not just existence)
Any client-side defect the e2e exposes is fixed in app/src/client/ with the spec re-run green afterwards
cd app && npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint + prettier clean on all touched files; work committed (Conventional Commit)

Together with the already-committed server work, this covers the remaining TASK-40 acceptance: the dock UI Sell panel (resource rows with base prices, sellable amount per source with selectors, Sell action), sell feedback (credits counter updates within one snapshot, source stack decreases), and the e2e 'sell 5 units in the browser, assert the credits counter text updated (screenshot)'
notes: PICKS UP WHERE THE SECOND FAILED TASK-40 ATTEMPT STOPPED. All of its work is committed as 3122ad1 (wip(TASK-40)); the working tree is clean; no background processes expected. The handoff .ralph/handoff/TASK-40.md still exists and its 'Next steps' section is the step-1 flow above, verbatim.

Already done in 3122ad1 — DO NOT REDO: shared/sell.ts (sellUnitPrice — the single price read site, widened to string with an isResourceId guard; sellFrom — pure atomic sell step, denial codes invalid-resource|invalid-amount|insufficient; sellableTotal) and shared/world/terminals.ts (one terminal per pad at the pad edge, pad.radius - 2 m, TERMINAL_RANGE_M = 10); repo.updateShipCargo; shard.handleSell — the SINGLE handler behind both the WS 'sell' frame and POST /api/ships/sell (validation ladder: own ship -> valid resource -> positive-integer amount -> !docked && !padId = not-docked -> source 'inv' requires the character within 10 m of a terminal else not-at-station -> sellFrom; success = stack decrement + addCredits in ONE repo.withTransaction, rollback -> sell-failed; 'sold' event; 'sell' RESULT frame validated against the wire schema); terminal entity spawn in the shard constructor; the 'ui-open' dock payload now carries hold+inventory (free-form z.record, no schema change); the 'sell' schema is a UNION of the request form {resourceId, amount, source} and the result form {resourceId, sold, earned, balance, hold, inventory}; POST /api/ships/sell route (400 unknown resource/bad body, 404 no ship, 409 not-in-system/not-docked/not-at-station, 422 insufficient, 500 else, success {sold, earned, newBalance}); dev e2e endpoints GET /api/dev/terminal-target + POST /api/dev/teleport-char (pre-existing: /api/dev/pad-target, /api/dev/teleport, /api/dev/give).

Green before this task starts (33 tests, re-runnable via `cd app && npx vitest run src/shared/sell.test.ts src/shared/world/terminals.test.ts src/server/shard/shard.sell.test.ts src/server/galaxy/sell.ws.test.ts`): sell.test.ts (11), terminals.test.ts (9), shard.sell.test.ts (7 — station checks, validation ladder, atomicity ROLLBACK, sold event), sell.ws.test.ts (6 — the FULL LOOP mine 10 iron (fake) -> transfer to hold -> dock -> sell -> credits 500 + 10*5 = 550 over BOTH WS 'sell' and REST, plus not-docked / not-at-station / insufficient 422 / unknown resource 400 / invalid body 400).

Client built in 3122ad1 (NEVER BROWSER-TESTED — that is what this task verifies): state/dock.ts, state/credits.ts, state/credit-float.ts, ui/dock-panel.tsx (#dock-panel, #dock-balance; SELL tab live with per-source buttons aria-label 'sell 1 <res> hold|inv' and 'sell all <res> hold|inv', rows show base price + 'hold N - inv M'; SHIPS/REPAIR tabs are TASK-53 stubs), ui/credits-hud.tsx (#credits-counter renders '{value} cr', hidden until a balance lands; CreditFloatLayer '+N cr' rise-and-fade), main.tsx (ui-open -> openDockPanel; 'sell' result frame -> applySellResult + setCredits + pushCreditFloat; boot effect fetches GET /api/players/me to seed the counter; renders <DockPanel onSend>, <CreditsCounter>, <CreditFloatLayer>).

E2E facts: iron base price 5, weight 1 u, scout hold capacity 40 u (so 5 iron = 5/40 u); new players start at 500 credits (the claim response flow); the fixture boots the dev server itself — run `npm run test:e2e sell.spec.ts`, never alongside `npm run dev`.

DEAD ENDS FROM THE ATTEMPTS (already fixed — do not re-derive): (1) sellUnitPrice was originally typed (resourceId: ResourceId), making its 'throws on unknown id' branch unreachable and breaking the unit test that passes 'plutonium' — it is now widened to string + isResourceId guard; (2) the 'ui-open' dock frame initially carried only {terminalId}, but the panel sits ~18 m from the docked ship (PAD_RADIUS_M 20, terminal at the edge) — beyond cargo_open's 5 m reach — so hold+inventory ride the ui-open payload instead; (3) `this.repo` types the sell methods as Partial (optional), so a `typeof X !== 'function'` guard does NOT narrow inside the withTransaction closure (TS2722) — the fix is an in-branch typeof re-check + defensive throw.

OUT OF SCOPE (TASK-40.2): the full `npm run test` suite (NOT re-run since 3122ad1 — expected ~3 min / ~119 files, with documented flaky load-sensitive perf benchmarks that pass in isolation), eslint/prettier on the 3122ad1 files not touched here, and the bookkeeping (step flags, passes, LOG.md, handoff deletion, DONE promise).
